name: atlas
description: Split ergonomic keyboard — ergogen-driven PCB generation.

scripts.render: kicad-cli pcb render --side top --width 1600 --height 1100 --quality high --output tools/renders/atlas-top.png pcb/kicad/keyboard.kicad_pcb && kicad-cli pcb render --side bottom --width 1600 --height 1100 --quality high --output tools/renders/atlas-bottom.png pcb/kicad/keyboard.kicad_pcb
